messages:
maya: Heads-up — we found a small but reproducible mem leak in the embed worker that spikes after ~30m of traffic. Can we use the 23:15-23:30 'twilight' mini change window to push a hotfix? Needs expedited approval and a quick canary.

samir: Ack. I can own the deploy if we get ops signoff. Patch is a single-line allocator fix, built as 2026-03-23T21:40:00Z image sha: sha256:abc123.

julie: I can be oncall for the window, will monitor SLOs. What rollback criteria do we want? CPU >80% or error-rate >0.5%?

maya: Rollback if error-rate >0.3% or latency p50 regresses >200ms over baseline. Also abort if canary fails health-checks for 2 consecutive probes. :warning:

ben: Docs & release note snippet in Google doc: https://go.redwood/example/hotfix-twilight — minimal, add note about allocating fix and backfill plan.

samir: deploy-bot, request expedited-approval for hotfix 2026-03-23T23:15 window, artifact sha256:abc123, canary targets: eu-west1 (5%) -> global (100%), strategy: linear 5->25->100 over 7m.

deploy-bot: @samir received expedited-approval request. Required approvals: ops_oncall, product_owner. Current approvals: none. To approve, react with :thumbsup: or reply `approve`.

ops_oncall: approve — I reviewed the metrics and the patch. I'll watch the canary. :white_check_mark:

maya: approve — thumbs up from me as release owner. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: ops_oncall, maya. Starting canary rollout to eu-west1 at 23:15:30 UTC. Canary window: 5 minutes. Monitoring SLI thresholds: error-rate, p50 latency, mem-usage.

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 5% -> 25% after 90s. No regressions detected. Metrics summary link: https://go.redwood/rollouts/6167778888

samir: Proceed to 100% when stable. I'll keep a cancellation command ready.

julie: Observability hooks set: traces, heap profiles on high mem. If mem climbs >200MB baseline for 2 minutes, I'll trigger rollback.

samir: Running final promote: `deploybot promote --rollout-id=6167778888 --to=100 --wait=false` (will monitor).

deploy-bot: Promotion started. Deploying to remaining regions.

deploy-bot: SUCCESS: rollout complete at 23:19:05 UTC. No immediate regressions.

maya: Nice. Small follow-ups: update release notes, schedule a 1h postmortem for next week to document root cause and retro.

ben: I'll update release notes now and ping legal for the customer-facing blurb.

julie: Leaving a bookmark on the incident channel and will keep watch for next 30m. If anything, call me oncall.

samir: If we need to rollback: `deploybot rollback --rollout-id=6167778888 --to=previous` — I have the command and will execute after confirming with ops_oncall.

maya: Closing thread: hotfix live, monitoring window in effect until 23:45 UTC. Thanks everyone. :tada:
